request: Draw how the MonoRail app updates itself. The app checks GitHub releases for a new version 30 seconds after startup and then every 4 hours. When an update is available, a pop-up offers three choices: "Download and Restart", "Ignore for six hours", or close it with the X (hidden until the next check). If the user picks Download and Restart, the update downloads. If a global backup folder is set and "Back up before updating" is on (it is by default), MonoRail then backs up every global item into a before-update folder, after the download and before the installer runs. If that backup fails the update is held, and the user can choose Try again or Update without a backup. With no backup folder set the update is never held up. Then the installer runs and the app restarts.
